description: This file defines API endpoints related to user authentication, including registration, login, profile retrieval, profile update, and token refresh for a sports live stream platform backend.

methods.name: register_user(user_data: UserCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user, hash their password, save user data to database, and generate an access token.

methods.name: login_user(login_data: UserLogin, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Authenticate user credentials and return a JWT token if valid.

methods.name: get_current_user_profile( current_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieve the profile details of the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: update_current_user_profile( user_update: UserUpdate, current_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Update profile details for the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: refresh_access_token( current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Generate a new access token for the authenticated user.
